title: Kunsthal Rotterdam, Museumnacht
excerpt: My first large outdoor projection mapping: the facade of the Kunsthal Rotterdam for Museumnacht 2017.
description:
For Museumnacht 2017 Jan Willem Campmans and I mapped the facade of the Kunsthal Rotterdam. It was my first large outdoor projection mapping project, and the start of the building-scale work that followed.
> The Kunsthal's facade is already a composition of planes and materials, so the mapping followed the building rather than covering it, letting content run along its own lines and edges until the architecture read as something built out of light.
credits: Projection mapping: Jaco Schilp and Jan Willem Campmans, with LiGHT-UP Collective. Presented during Museumnacht at the Kunsthal Rotterdam, 2017.
